chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Amr ibn Thabit, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Wash your hands in one vessel, so that your manners may be improved.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and social benefit of washing hands from a single vessel according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith linking physical cleanliness to moral refinement, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between outward actions (zahir) and inward character (akhlaq). The instruction to wash from a single vessel underscores communal harmony and humility, transforming a routine act of hygiene into a spiritual practice that fosters social cohesion among diners.
